note: Dictated split sentences (English, the demo language). Each case is spoken by every voice; synthetic tracks go in synthetic/ (generated by pnpm ai:eval:speech with macOS say), recorded tracks will go in recorded/<case id>-<speaker>.wav. `spoken` overrides what the synthetic voice reads, when it mispronounces a word ('pho' is read 'foe'). `keywords`: the words the split depends on; a keyword matches a heard word that starts with it (coke ~ cokes).
